details.description: Llama 4 Scout is Meta's Llama 4 chat model, released April 5, 2025 alongside Maverick. It uses a mixture-of-experts architecture with 17 billion active parameters across 16 experts (about 109 billion total parameters), and, like Maverick, was pretrained on roughly 200 languages, including more than 100 with over a billion tokens each. It serves chat completions with a 131,072-token context window. Meta reports it outperforms Gemma 3, Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite, and Mistral 3.1 across benchmarks for its size class, with particular strength in multi-document summarization and large-codebase analysis.
advantages: Scores 74.3 on MMLU Pro and 57.2 on GPQA Diamond, per its Hugging Face model card.
Meta reports it outperforms Gemma 3, Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite, and Mistral 3.1 across benchmarks for its size class.
Pretrained on roughly 200 languages, including more than 100 with over a billion tokens each, per Meta's Llama 4 launch post.
disadvantages: Static model with an August 2024 knowledge cutoff, per its model card.

sources.title: The Llama 4 herd: The beginning of a new era of natively multimodal AI innovation

notes: Catalog facts list a 131,072-token context window and text-only (text_input/text_output) modality for this entry, so that is what I described. Meta's own pages describe the base Llama 4 Scout model as natively multimodal (text + image input) with an industry-leading 10,000,000-token context window -- both notably larger/different than the catalog facts. Kept the catalog's values per instructions; flagging the gap for review. Language list (12 names) and the 'pretrained on ~200 languages' figure both come from Meta's own sources and describe two different things (officially supported chat languages vs. pretraining-corpus diversity), so both are included. Verification pass: the original 79.6 MMLU (5-shot) / 50.3 MATH (4-shot) scores were the pretrained BASE checkpoint's numbers from the Hugging Face card's other table (compared there against Llama 3.1 70B/405B), not the Instruct model's; replaced with the Instruct-tuned model's own MMLU Pro (74.3) and GPQA Diamond (57.2) scores from the same card.
